|game_text='''0 side — Rebel Strike Team'''

Deploy Endor system and Rebel Landing Site. {While} this side up, opponent loses no more than 1 Force from each of your Force drains at Endor locations. Once during each of your deploy phases, may use 2 Force to take one Bunker or Deactivate The Shield Generator into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if Bunker 'blown away' or if, during your move phase, you control three exterior Endor sites (with two Rebel scouts at each). {Place} out of play if Endor 'blown away.'

'''7 side — Garrison Destroyed'''

{While} this side up, at each Endor site where you have a Rebel scout, your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent, except by a 'react'. Rebel scouts are immune to attrition &lt; 4. Once during each of your draw phases, may retrieve one Rebel scout of ability &lt; 3. Your Epic Event destiny draws are each +2. {Flip} this card (unless Bunker 'blown away') if, during an opponent's move phase, opponent controls three exterior Endor sites or Endor system. {Place} out of play if Endor is 'blown away'.
